scripts.build:dev: node build-seo.mjs . && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const out='dist';fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync('.')){if(['node_modules','dist','.git','.lovable','api','.vercel','build-seo.mjs','fixup.mjs'].includes(e))continue;const s=fs.statSync(e);if(s.isDirectory()){fs.cpSync(e,path.join(out,e),{recursive:true});}else{fs.copyFileSync(e,path.join(out,e));}}console.log('copied static site to '+out);"
